title: Softwire is the right size with a modern stack but an unverified open-source posture
content:
Softwire is a London bespoke development shop that the assessment reads as the right size with a modern stack. Bespoke delivery means no proprietary platform to protect, and size is the axis on which most leads in this set fail — several otherwise strong candidates are held back purely for being too large.

The open-source posture is unverified and the stack was not researched in detail, so the screen is incomplete rather than negative. As with the other right-size UK leads, that screen is the only work standing between the current priority-3 placement and a decision either way.
